title: an is_bool() guard makes the true literal of a string|true parameter unreachable

ground_truth.statement: true is a bool, so is_bool($value) is true for it and the literal takes the early return; the only value left for accept_string() is a string. The call is sound and the declared parameter type of accept_string() is the runtime witness.

notes: Companion of narrowing/is-numeric-guard-excludes-int with a literal alternative instead of a primitive: the guard has to remove `true` specifically. PHP 8.2 is the floor because the fixture uses the standalone true type.
